title: Keyturn Roadside Assistance: Persons Covered to Call and the Trip Excess Waiver by Plan
content:
Who may call for assistance under a Keyturn Roadside Assistance plan, and whether the excess is waived
where the vehicle was on a marketplace trip, are set plan by plan.

| Plan | A guest driving the vehicle may call | The host may call between trips | The excess is waived where the vehicle was on a marketplace trip |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Keyturn Roadside Basic Cover | no | yes | no |
| Keyturn Roadside Plus Cover | yes | yes | yes |
| Keyturn Roadside Tow Cover | yes | yes | yes |
| Keyturn Roadside EV Cover | yes | yes | yes |
| Keyturn Roadside Fleet Cover | yes | yes | yes |
| Keyturn Roadside Concierge Cover | yes | yes | yes |

### The schedule read the other way about

The host may call on all six plans. Keyturn Roadside Basic Cover is the single plan on which a guest
driving the vehicle is not covered to call, and the single plan on which the excess is not waived for
a vehicle that was on a marketplace trip. On Keyturn Roadside Plus Cover, Keyturn Roadside Tow Cover,
Keyturn Roadside EV Cover, Keyturn Roadside Fleet Cover and Keyturn Roadside Concierge Cover both the
guest cover and the trip waiver are carried together.
